The literal arm binds in ReportSectionBinder.BindCodeClause (a two-character nonnumeric literal, §1985:XIII.3.6.3 SR1; anything else COBOL2713, the identifier operand included). The word IS (2002 13.16.12.1 `CODE IS`) is construct report-code-is-2002 (VisitReportCodeClause). Witnesses: 1985-FMT-XIII_3_6_2 and pb5242-code-is-85 (CODE IS "AB" refused at 85). Each 2002 form is refused at --std 85 with COBOL0900 by a construct row of the version matrix (tests/version-matrix/constructs/report-*-2002.json, introducedIn 2002), checked on recognition in VersionConformancePass's parse arm, and accepted from COBOL-2002 (ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 115).
